measure.sentenceEn: It is unarguable that our laboratories, scientific instruments, rockets and satellites—the tools we scientists need to measure the planet's pulse—demand significant amounts of energy both in their construction and operation.
measure.translationZh: 无可争辩的是，我们的实验室、科学仪器、火箭和卫星——这些科学家用来测量地球脉搏的工具——在建造和运行过程中都需要消耗大量能源。
measure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

measure.sentenceEn: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
measure.translationZh: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不应只包含短期应急响应，还应推荐能够让社区更凉爽的中长期措施。
measure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

measure.sentenceEn: Another measure could be encouraging friendships between children in different school years to mirror the unsupervised mixed-age playgroups in hunter-gatherer communities.
measure.translationZh: 另一项措施可以是鼓励不同学年的孩子建立友谊，以模仿狩猎采集社群中无人监督的混龄游戏群体。
measure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

measure.sentenceEn: The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title's impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates.
measure.translationZh: 科学界通过多种方式衡量这些论文的质量，包括期刊的公认质量（体现在该刊的影响因子上）以及特定论文积累的引用次数。
measure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

measure.sentenceEn: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?
measure.translationZh: 以下哪项措施会得到生产力委员会的支持？

measure.sentenceEn: they have to step up security measures .
measure.translationZh: 他们必须加强安全措施。

million.sentenceEn: With more than 6.8 million on waitlists, healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those who cannot opt to pay for private treatment; and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezing out investment in other public services.
million.translationZh: 等待名单上的人数已超过680万，对于那些无法选择私人医疗服务的人来说，医疗资源变得越来越难以获取；同时，医疗服务的提供成本不断攀升，正逐渐挤占其他公共服务的投资空间。
million.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

million.sentenceEn: According to the website Lexica, which tracks over 10 million Stable Diffusion images and prompts, Rutkowski's name has been used as a prompt around 93,000 times.
million.translationZh: 据追踪超过1000万张Stable Diffusion图像和提示词的网站Lexica统计，鲁特科夫斯基的名字已被用作提示词约93,000次。
million.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

million.sentenceEn: Why had the Romans buried a million nails?
million.translationZh: 罗马人为何要埋下一百万根钉子？
million.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

million.sentenceEn: For example, type in "Wizard with sword and a glowing orb of magic fire fights a fierce dragon Greg Rutkowski," and the system will produce something that looks not a million miles away from works in Rutkowski's style.
million.translationZh: 例如，输入"手持宝剑与魔法火焰发光宝珠的巫师大战凶猛巨龙 Greg Rutkowski"，系统就会生成与Rutkowski风格作品相差无几的图像。
million.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

million.sentenceEn: Nearly 2,000 years ago, as the Romans began to pull out of Scotland, they left behind a curious treasure: 10 tons of nails, nearly a million of the things.
million.translationZh: 近两千年前，当罗马人开始撤离苏格兰时，他们留下了一批奇特的宝藏：10吨铁钉，总数近百万枚。
million.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

million.sentenceEn: Each year researchers publish millions of papers in more than 30,000 journals.
million.translationZh: 研究人员每年在三万多种期刊上发表数百万篇论文。
million.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

major.sentenceEn: "Insects that today are a minor problem may become a major problem if they can produce three or four generations in a year," says forest ecologist John Stanturf.
major.translationZh: 森林生态学家约翰·斯坦特夫表示：“如果某些昆虫一年能繁殖三到四代，那么如今只是小麻烦的它们，未来可能会演变成大问题。”
major.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

major.sentenceEn: Their work deals with one of the problems that could block major restoration efforts in different parts of the world.
major.translationZh: 他们的工作涉及一个可能会阻碍全球多地开展重大修复工程的问题。
major.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

major.sentenceEn: Yet despite two decades of strategies and a number of major health reforms, we have failed to make meaningful progress on any of these aims.
major.translationZh: 然而，尽管二十年来我们制定了各种策略并实施了多项重大医疗改革，但在实现这些目标方面我们并未取得实质性进展。
major.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

major.sentenceEn: "If you already know your major , having an extracurricular that fits into that major can be a big plus," says Mayghin Levine, the manager of educational opportunities with The Cabbage Patch Settlement House, a Louisville, Kentucky, nonprofit community center.
major.translationZh: 肯塔基州路易斯维尔市非营利社区中心——卷心菜地定居之家的教育机会部经理梅金·莱文表示：“如果你已经确定了自己的专业，那么参加与该专业相关的课外活动将会是一个很大的加分项。”
major.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

major.sentenceEn: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?
major.translationZh: 18世纪末以后，是什么在降低钉子价格方面起了主要作用？

major.sentenceEn: Major social issues should be the focus of legislation.
major.translationZh: 重大社会问题应成为立法的重点。

material.sentenceEn: Because flammable material couldn't build up on the landscape, blazes tended to move slowly and peter out when they reached the footprints of previous burns.
material.translationZh: 由于易燃物无法在地面上堆积，火势往往蔓延缓慢，并在蔓延至先前的过火区域时逐渐熄灭。
material.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

material.sentenceEn: "Where's the planting material going to come from? That's one big bottleneck," says genetic-resources specialist Ramni Jamnadass.
material.translationZh: “种苗从哪里来？这是一个巨大的瓶颈，”遗传资源专家拉姆尼·贾姆纳达斯说道。
material.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

material.sentenceEn: ACE says it's helped shrink the number of illegal streaming services in North America to 126, from more than 1,400 in 2018, aided in part by the MPA's support for a 2020 federal law that made large-scale streaming of copyrighted material a serious crime.
material.translationZh: 美国电影协会（ACE）表示，其已协助将北美地区的非法流媒体服务数量从2018年的1400多家减少至126家。这在一定程度上得益于MPA支持的2020年联邦法律，该法律将大规模流媒体传播受版权保护的材料定为严重犯罪。
material.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

material.sentenceEn: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.
material.translationZh: 在创作之时，人们并未刻意进行保存，但这些模拟材料却有可能幸存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
material.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

material.sentenceEn: Artists say they risk losing income as people start using AI-generated images based on copyrighted material for commercial purposes.
material.translationZh: 艺术家们表示，随着人们开始将基于受版权保护材料生成的AI图像用于商业目的，他们面临着收入损失的风险。
material.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

material.sentenceEn: Later civilisations would value the skilled blacksmith's labour in a nail even more than the raw material .
material.translationZh: 后世文明更看重钉子中蕴含的铁匠精湛技艺，而非其原材料本身。
material.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

media.sentenceEn: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.
media.translationZh: 交通中断已变得日益频繁，火车晚期现已成为意大利媒体报道中的常态。
media.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

media.sentenceEn: AI can also be used to identify the lifestyle choices of customers regarding their hobbies, favourite celebrities, and fashions to provide unique content in marketing messages put out through social media .
media.translationZh: 人工智能还可用于识别客户在爱好、喜爱的名人及时尚方面的生活方式选择，从而为通过社交媒体发布的营销信息提供独特内容。
media.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

media.sentenceEn: Data can be gathered on where the customer can be engaged, such as location, devices used, website interactions, and sites visited, to display marketing messages in appropriate forms, including emails, social media posts, pop-up advertisements, and banners at an appropriate frequency.
media.translationZh: 可以收集有关客户互动渠道的数据，例如位置、使用的设备、网站交互和访问过的站点，以便以适当的形式（包括电子邮件、社交媒体帖子、弹窗广告和横幅）并按适当的频率展示营销信息。
media.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

media.sentenceEn: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax," meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon—in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
media.translationZh: 许多法国政界人士和媒体将其称为"GAFA税"，这意味着该税主要针对谷歌、苹果、脸书和亚马逊等公司——换句话说，就是总部设在美国的跨国科技企业。
media.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

media.sentenceEn: Most Americans rely on social media to check daily headlines.
media.translationZh: 大多数美国人依赖社交媒体查看每日新闻标题。
media.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

media.sentenceEn: One reason for the persistence of this pyramid of production is that for the past half-century, much of the world's media culture has been defined by a single medium – television – and television is defined by downloading.
media.translationZh: 这种创作金字塔得以持续存在的一个原因是，在过去半个世纪里，世界上大部分的媒体文化都由单一媒介——电视——所定义，而电视的本质就是下载。

mental.sentenceEn: Different parts of our brain engage as we simulate scenes, characters and mental states.
mental.translationZh: 当我们模拟场景、角色和心理状态时，大脑的不同区域会参与其中。

mental.sentenceEn: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
mental.translationZh: 身临其境地体验科学家的生活，见证重大突破是如何在偶然、冲突以及非凡的意志力中诞生的。

mental.sentenceEn: But outside those narrow pools of interest, a vast ocean awaits, bountiful with simmering ideas, mental adventure and imaginative refreshment.
mental.translationZh: 但在那些狭隘的兴趣圈子之外，有一片浩瀚的海洋正等待着人们去探索，那里充满了各种酝酿中的思想、智力上的冒险，以及想象力的洗礼。

mental.sentenceEn: Loneliness is known to impact on your mental health and contribute to a low mood.
mental.translationZh: 众所周知，孤独会影响心理健康，并导致情绪低落。
mental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

mental.sentenceEn: Whether it is a mental health app, a fitness tracker, a connected health device or something else, many of us are taking advantage of this technology to keep better track of our health in some shape or form.
mental.translationZh: 无论是心理健康应用、健身追踪器、联网健康设备还是其他相关应用，我们中的许多人都在以某种方式利用这类技术来更好地追踪自己的健康状况。
mental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

mental.sentenceEn: If you are unfamiliar with words or idioms, you guess at their meaning, using clues presented in the context. On the assumption that they will become relevant later, you make a mental note of discourse entities as well as possible links between them.
mental.translationZh: 遇到不熟悉的单词或习语时，你会借助上下文中的提示来猜测它们的含义。由于假定这些内容在后续可能会变得重要，你会在脑海中记住语篇实体以及它们之间可能存在的联系。

management.sentenceEn: Not only does understanding the equines' genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
management.translationZh: 作者写道，了解马科动物的基因构成不仅有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，而且随着气候变化改变地球环境，这还可能改善未来对它们的管理。
management.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

management.sentenceEn: Particularly useful in busy locations or during times of emergency, the doors act as crowd management by reducing the obstacles put in people's way.
management.translationZh: 在繁忙场所或紧急情况下，自动门尤为实用，它们通过减少行人通行障碍来辅助人群疏导。
management.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

management.sentenceEn: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management .
management.translationZh: 其前提是，普通合同法未能为劳动者提供足够的保护，以抵御管理层的任意行为。
management.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

management.sentenceEn: When Microsoft bought task management app Wunderlist and mobile calendar Sunrise in 2015, it picked two newcomers that were attracting considerable buzz in Silicon Valley.
management.translationZh: 2015年，微软收购任务管理应用Wunderlist和移动日历应用Sunrise时，选中的是两家在硅谷已引起不小轰动的新兴企业。
management.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

management.sentenceEn: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
management.translationZh: 从根本上讲，美国邮政署正处于历史性的双重挤压之中：一方面是技术变革永久性地降低了对其核心产品——一类邮件的需求，另一方面是监管结构剥夺了管理层调整业务以适应新现实的灵活性。
management.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

management.sentenceEn: In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work – such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management , and infrastructure upkeep – that affect the lives of all Americans.
management.translationZh: 实际上，如今用于该机构其他工作的联邦资金减少了——例如森林保护、流域和文化资源管理以及基础设施维护——而这些工作影响着所有美国人的生活。
management.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

medium.sentenceEn: The thing itself is the medium that delivers the information.
medium.translationZh: 事物本身就是传递信息的媒介。
medium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

medium.sentenceEn: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
medium.translationZh: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不应只包含短期应急响应，还应推荐能够让社区更凉爽的中长期措施。
medium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

medium.sentenceEn: At the same time AI can also be used to generate content for social media posts and chat sites.
medium.translationZh: 同时，人工智能还可用于为社交媒体帖子和聊天网站生成内容。
medium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

medium.sentenceEn: You'll have to make social media an occasional activity rather than a daily, time-consuming habit.
medium.translationZh: 你得把社交媒体变成偶尔为之的活动，而非每日必做的耗时习惯。
medium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

medium.sentenceEn: A 2014 survey conducted in Australia, Britain, and the United States by the University of Wisconsin-Madison found that young people's reliance on social media led to greater political engagement.
medium.translationZh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校2014年在澳大利亚、英国和美国开展的一项调查发现，年轻人对社交媒体的依赖提高了他们的政治参与度。
medium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

medium.sentenceEn: adolescents should form healthy social media habits.
medium.translationZh: 青少年应当养成健康的社交媒体使用习惯。

marketing.sentenceEn: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.
marketing.translationZh: 市面上有如此多的产品在巨额广告和营销预算的推波助澜下进行促销，以至于人们很容易成为受害者。
marketing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

marketing.sentenceEn: There has been some exploration around the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in digital marketing .
marketing.translationZh: 目前已有一些关于在数字营销中运用人工智能(AI)的探索。
marketing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

marketing.sentenceEn: Data can be gathered on where the customer can be engaged, such as location, devices used, website interactions, and sites visited, to display marketing messages in appropriate forms, including emails, social media posts, pop-up advertisements, and banners at an appropriate frequency.
marketing.translationZh: 可以收集有关客户互动渠道的数据，例如位置、使用的设备、网站交互和访问过的站点，以便以适当的形式（包括电子邮件、社交媒体帖子、弹窗广告和横幅）并按适当的频率展示营销信息。
marketing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

marketing.sentenceEn: The non-intrusive delivery of the marketing messages in a way that is sensitive to the needs of target customers is one of the critical challenges to the digital marketer.
marketing.translationZh: 以对目标客户需求敏感的方式实现营销信息的非侵入式传递，是数字营销人员面临的关键挑战之一。
marketing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

marketing.sentenceEn: The main disadvantage of using AI to respond to customers is that there are concerns about trusting personal interactions to machines, which could lead not only to the subsequent loss of interpersonal connections, but also to a decrease in marketing personnel.
marketing.translationZh: 使用人工智能回应客户的主要缺点在于，人们对于将人际互动交由机器处理存在顾虑，这不仅可能导致后续人际连接的丧失，还可能造成营销人员的减少。
marketing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

marketing.sentenceEn: Not only can AI help to create the marketing content, but it can also provide a non-intrusive way of delivering the content to the target customers.
marketing.translationZh: 人工智能不仅能协助创建营销内容，还能以一种非侵入式的方式向目标客户传递这些内容。
marketing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

moral.sentenceEn: The moral of the story is simple.
moral.translationZh: 这个故事的寓意很简单。
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

moral.sentenceEn: This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing.
moral.translationZh: 这就是为什么研究人员通常认为，适量的所谓道德内疚是一件好事。
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

moral.sentenceEn: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms.
moral.translationZh: 与悲伤、恐惧和愤怒等所谓的基本情绪不同，内疚感出现得稍晚一些，它伴随着孩子对社会规范和道德准则的理解逐渐加深而产生。
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

moral.sentenceEn: They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions – a kind of " moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.
moral.translationZh: 这些做法甚至可能产生负面影响：它们满足了我们"尽了一份力"的心理需求，却使我们无法采取更大胆、更有力、更有效的行动——这是一种"道德许可"，它缓解了我们的担忧，阻止我们采取更多行动，也不再对当权者提出更高要求。
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

moral.sentenceEn: Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions.
moral.translationZh: 她通过照料者的评估和孩子们的自我观察，对每个孩子的整体同情心水平以及在道德失范行为后产生负面情绪的倾向进行了评分。
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

moral.sentenceEn: Moral awareness matters in editing a newspaper.
moral.translationZh: 编辑报纸时，道德意识至关重要。

maintain.sentenceEn: In an effort to support restoration programmes, specialists are developing supplies of seeds and seedlings, maintaining gene banks and sequencing the genomes of indigenous trees and other crops.
maintain.translationZh: 为了支持恢复计划，专家们正在增加种子和树苗的供应，维护基因库，并对本土树木和其他作物的基因组进行测序。
maintain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

maintain.sentenceEn: Yet how was that universality of access made possible and, perhaps more importantly, how is it maintained ?
maintain.translationZh: 然而，这种普遍获取是如何实现的？或许更重要的是，它又是如何维持的？
maintain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

maintain.sentenceEn: The two highly recommended lifestyle approaches are maintaining or increasing your level of aerobic exercise and following a Mediterranean-style diet that is high in fiber and eliminates highly processed foods.
maintain.translationZh: 两种高度推荐的生活方式是保持或增加有氧运动水平，以及遵循地中海式饮食——这种饮食富含纤维并排除高度加工食品。
maintain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

maintain.sentenceEn: Meanwhile there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental well-being.
maintain.translationZh: 与此同时，随着年龄增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并维持肌肉量，以保护你的身心健康。
maintain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

maintain.sentenceEn: "Whether you're a politician or a parent, it might be helpful to keep in mind that trying to maintain eye contact may backfire if you're trying to convince someone who has a different set of beliefs than you," said Minson.
maintain.translationZh: 明森指出：“无论你是政治家还是为人父母，都应该记住，当你试图说服与你持有不同信念的人时，刻意保持眼神接触可能会适得其反。”
maintain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

maintain.sentenceEn: In fact, the ability to emotionally regulate or maintain emotional control when confronted by stress is one of the most important of all life's skills.
maintain.translationZh: 事实上，在面对压力时能够进行情绪调节或保持情绪控制，是人生中最重要的技能之一。
maintain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

mainly.sentenceEn: But switching to a mainly plant-based diet wouldn't help.
mainly.translationZh: 但是转向以植物为主的饮食也无济于事。
mainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

mainly.sentenceEn: The common idea that high CEO pay is mainly about ripping people off doesn't explain history very well.
mainly.translationZh: 那种认为首席执行官的高薪主要是通过剥削他人得来的普遍观点，并不能很好地解释历史。
mainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

mainly.sentenceEn: These new forms were at first mainly written by scholars and performed by amateurs, but in England, as everywhere else in western Europe, the growth of a class of professional actors was threatening to make the drama popular, whether it should be new or old, classical or medieval, literary or farcical.
mainly.translationZh: 这些新形式最初主要由学者创作，由业余爱好者表演，但在英国，如同西欧其他各地一样，职业演员阶层的兴起正推动戏剧走向大众化，无论其是新是旧、古典还是中世纪、文学性还是滑稽性。
mainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

mainly.sentenceEn: When social scientists do tackle practical issues, their scope is often local: Belgium is interested mainly in the effects of poverty on Belgium, for example.
mainly.translationZh: 当社会科学家确实着手解决实际问题时，他们的研究范围往往局限于本地：例如，比利时的研究主要关注贫困对比利时本国的影响。
mainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

mainly.sentenceEn: His concern is mainly with the humanities: literature, languages, philosophy and so on.
mainly.translationZh: 他主要关注的是人文学科：文学、语言学、哲学等等。

mainly.sentenceEn: What is the text mainly about?
mainly.translationZh: 这篇文章主要讲了什么内容？

majority.sentenceEn: Specifically, a 5-4 majority decided that wetlands protected by the EPA under its Clean Water Act authority must have a "continuous surface connection" to bodies of water.
majority.translationZh: 具体而言，以5票对4票的多数意见裁定，美国环境保护局根据《清洁水法》授权所保护的湿地必须与水体具有“持续的地表连接”。
majority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

majority.sentenceEn: The bill proved largely popular and sailed through Congress with large majorities in favor.
majority.translationZh: 该法案获得了广泛支持，并以压倒性多数在国会顺利通过。

majority.sentenceEn: Zoos are, in that sense, similar to natural history and archeology museums, serving to satisfy our need for contact with these living creatures while leaving the vast majority undisturbed in their natural environments.
majority.translationZh: 从这个意义上说，动物园类似于自然历史博物馆和考古博物馆，它们满足了我们与这些生物接触的需求，同时让绝大多数生物在其自然环境中不受打扰。
majority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

majority.sentenceEn: The Republican-penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission's authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything.
majority.translationZh: 这份由共和党人起草的命令不仅废除了FCC在2015年民主党占多数时通过的严格网络中立规则，还否定了该委员会对宽带提供商实施诸多监管的权力。
majority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

majority.sentenceEn: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of 'Smiling Victorians' makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently into the middle distance.
majority.translationZh: 当然，我必须承认，我收集的这些'微笑的维多利亚人'照片，只占1840至1900年间浩如烟海的人像摄影作品中的极小一部分。绝大多数照片中的人物都在彩绘背景前摆着痛苦而僵硬的姿势，或是茫然地凝视着远方。
majority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

majority.sentenceEn: Like the majority of authors, he had to suffer many disappointments and rejections along the way, but these made him all the more determined to succeed.
majority.translationZh: 和大多数作家一样，他在写作之路上也经历了许多失望与退稿，但这些挫折反而让他更加坚定了成功的决心。
majority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

mass.sentenceEn: However, the signaling in a plant is only superficially similar to the firing in a complex animal brain, which is more than "a mass of cells that communicate by electricity," Taiz said.
mass.translationZh: 然而，泰兹指出，植物体内的信号传导与复杂动物大脑中的神经冲动只是表面相似，而动物大脑远不止是'一团通过电流进行交流的细胞'。
mass.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

mass.sentenceEn: When it comes to AI in business, we often hear about it in relation to automation and the impending loss of jobs, but in what ways is AI changing companies and the larger economy that don't involve doom-and-gloom mass unemployment predictions?
mass.translationZh: 谈到商业领域的人工智能，我们常常听到它与自动化以及随之而来的失业风险相关联，但人工智能在哪些方面正在改变企业和整体经济，而不涉及那些悲观的大规模失业预测呢？
mass.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

mass.sentenceEn: Meanwhile there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental well-being.
mass.translationZh: 与此同时，随着年龄增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并维持肌肉量，以保护你的身心健康。
mass.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

mass.sentenceEn: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
mass.translationZh: 新加坡某机构首席执行官陈杰豪指出，只要决策是基于海量数据做出的，“你很快就会陷入诸多伦理问题之中”。该机构正协助政府制定人工智能伦理使用自愿准则。
mass.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

mass.sentenceEn: I had gained weight in the form of muscle mass , but thinking only of lowering the number on the scale, I altered my training program.
mass.translationZh: 我的体重确实增加了，但这是肌肉量增加的结果。然而，我一心只想着降低体重秤上的数字，于是调整了训练计划。
mass.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

mass.sentenceEn: Mass media are inclined to cover disasters and deaths.
mass.translationZh: 大众媒体倾向于报道灾难和死亡事件。

means.sentenceEn: Although these efforts were aimed at the nonscience-bound student, they never really made their way into mainstream thought and public discourse as a means to rally widespread support for the importance of science teaching in schools.
means.translationZh: 尽管这些努力旨在针对非科学专业的学生，但它们从未真正进入主流思想和公共舆论，未能成为一种在学校中争取广泛支持科学教育重要性的手段。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

means.sentenceEn: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike.
means.translationZh: 自2008年罗马至米兰的高铁网络开通以来，火车已成为当地人和游客在意大利境内旅行的首选交通工具。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

means.sentenceEn: You don't even need any formal training, just an inquisitive mind and the enthusiasm to join one of the thousands of citizen science projects to generate new knowledge and the means to understand a genuine scientific outcome.
means.translationZh: 你甚至不需要任何正式培训，只需要一颗好奇的心和参与数千个公民科学项目的热情，就能为新知识的产生贡献力量，并理解真正的科学成果。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

means.sentenceEn: And it's a reminder that the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program has long been crucial as the means to transcend the influence of deep-pocketed special interests in neighboring states.
means.translationZh: 这也提醒我们，长期以来，美国环保署参与切萨皮克湾项目至关重要，因为它是超越邻州财力雄厚的特殊利益集团影响的重要手段。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

means.sentenceEn: Perhaps museums and governments might explore some role for the use of nearly exact reproductions as a means of resolving issues relating to returning works of art and antiquities.
means.translationZh: 或许博物馆和政府可以探索利用近乎精确的复制品，将其作为解决艺术品和古物返还相关问题的一种途径。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

means.sentenceEn: By using the first draft as a means of thinking about what you want to say, you will very likely discover more than your notes originally suggested. Plenty of good writers don't use outlines at all but discover ordering principles as they write. Do not attempt to compose a perfectly correct draft the first time around.
means.translationZh: 将初稿作为思考表达内容的工具，你很可能会发现比笔记中原先记录的更多东西。许多优秀作家完全不使用提纲，而是在写作过程中发现文章的组织结构。不要试图在第一次就写出完美无误的草稿。
means.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

manufacturing.sentenceEn: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing .
manufacturing.translationZh: 一个更直接的应对措施是拓宽我们的数字想象力，以构想那些不只是简单取代工作岗位，而是能在全国不同地区最关注的行业（如医疗保健、教育和制造业）中拓展机会的人工智能技术。
manufacturing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

manufacturing.sentenceEn: Goodall added: "While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance, we need our land to also provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing and contribute to net zero."
manufacturing.translationZh: 古德尔补充道：“虽然粮食生产和生物多样性健康显然至关重要，但我们也需要土地能够提供稳定的木材供应，用于建筑、制造业并助力实现净零目标。”
manufacturing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

manufacturing.sentenceEn: A recent survey of manufacturing and service industries from Tata Consultancy Services found that companies currently use AI more often in computer-to-computer activities than in automating human activities.
manufacturing.translationZh: 塔塔咨询服务公司近期针对制造业和服务业的一项调查发现，企业目前更多地将人工智能应用于计算机与计算机之间的交互活动，而非自动化人类活动。
manufacturing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

manufacturing.sentenceEn: Manufacturing is not the economic engine that it once was.
manufacturing.translationZh: 制造业已不再是曾经的经济引擎。
manufacturing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

manufacturing.sentenceEn: But even now, 54 percent of the jobs in the country are middle-skill jobs, such as construction and high-skill manufacturing .
manufacturing.translationZh: 但即便现在，美国54%的工作岗位仍为中等技能型工作，例如建筑业和高技能制造业。
manufacturing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

movement.sentenceEn: These groups of people are part of a rapidly expanding biotechnological social movement of citizen scientists and professional scientists seeking to take discovery out of institutions and put it into the hands of anyone with the enthusiasm.
movement.translationZh: 这些人群是一个迅速发展的生物技术社会运动的组成部分，该运动由公民科学家和专业科学家共同发起，旨在将科学发现从科研机构中解放出来，交到每一个充满热情的人手中。
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

movement.sentenceEn: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
movement.translationZh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

movement.sentenceEn: Each automatic door system analyses the light, sound, weight or movement in its vicinity as a signal to open.
movement.translationZh: 每个自动门系统都会分析其附近的光线、声音、重量或移动情况，并将这些作为开门信号。
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

movement.sentenceEn: And he was one of the founders of a movement called Romanticism, which celebrated the wonders of the natural world.
movement.translationZh: 他还是浪漫主义运动的创始人之一，该运动颂扬自然界的奇妙之处。
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

movement.sentenceEn: This movement , driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent.
movement.translationZh: 这场移民运动由各种强大的动机驱动，在一片荒野之上建立起一个国家，并且凭借其本质，塑造了这片未知大陆的性格与命运。
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

movement.sentenceEn: It is not by chance that the Funeral March is not the last movement of the Eroica Symphony, but the second, so that suffering does not have the last word.
movement.translationZh: 《英雄交响曲》的葬礼进行曲并非末乐章，而是第二乐章，这绝非偶然——如此安排，便是为了不让苦难成为最终的结局。

multiple.sentenceEn: With multiple networks and countless podcasts, a smartphone user selects what to hear and when.
multiple.translationZh: 面对众多的网络平台和无数的播客节目，智能手机用户可以自主选择收听的内容和时间。
multiple.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

massive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

massive.sentenceEn: Between them, the five biggest tech companies have spent an average of only $3.4 billion a year on sub-$1 billion acquisitions over the past five years—a drop in the ocean compared with their massive financial reserves, and the more than $130 billion of venture capital that was invested in the US last year.
massive.translationZh: 在过去五年中，这五家最大的科技公司平均每年仅花费34亿美元用于10亿美元以下的收购——与它们庞大的财务储备以及去年美国超过1300亿美元的风险投资相比，这只是沧海一粟。
massive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

massive.sentenceEn: Although electric cars are still a rarity on roads now, this massive investment could change the picture rapidly in coming years.
massive.translationZh: 尽管目前道路上的电动汽车仍较为少见，但这笔巨额投资可能会在未来几年迅速改变这一局面。
massive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Meanwhile , the number of annual visitors has increased by more than 50% since 1980, and now stands at 330 million visitors per year.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，自1980年以来，年游客量增长了50%以上，目前已达到每年3.3亿人次。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Meanwhile , Schwitzgebel—who had predicted no effect—will be eating his words.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，曾预测不会产生任何效果的施维茨格贝尔可要收回自己的话了。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Insurance companies, meanwhile , can base their premiums on AI models that more accurately assess risk.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，保险公司可以将保费基于能更准确评估风险的人工智能模型。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Meanwhile there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental well-being.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，随着年龄增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并维持肌肉量，以保护你的身心健康。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: In a 2019 survey of University of Georgia students, meanwhile , the career office found the most desirable trait in a future employer was the ability to offer secure employment (followed by professional development and training, and then inspiring purpose).
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，乔治亚大学就业指导办公室在2019年对本校学生的一项调查中发现，未来雇主最令人向往的特质是能够提供稳定的工作（其次是专业发展和培训，然后是鼓舞人心的目标）。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Meanwhile , the asocial robot simply moved forwards and backwards and side to side.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，非社交型机器人只是简单地前后左右移动。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: According to Sichel, although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy, most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.
manufacturer.translationZh: 西谢尔指出，尽管钉子价格下降部分源于铁价和能源成本的降低，但大部分功劳应归于钉子制造商——他们找到了将钢材转化为钉子的更高效方法。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: That's because they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers—who must pay fees or buy better vehicles—rather than on to the car manufacturers whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution.
manufacturer.translationZh: 这是因为这些措施不可避免地将净化空气的成本转嫁给了个体司机——他们必须支付费用或购买更环保的车辆——而非汽车制造商，而正是这些制造商的作弊行为才是造成我们有毒污染的真正原因。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: We're doing everything but insist that manufacturers clean up their cars.
manufacturer.translationZh: 我们什么都做了，唯独没有坚持要求制造商净化他们的汽车。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: The advance is driven in part by vehicle manufacturers , who are placing big bets on battery-powered electric vehicles.
manufacturer.translationZh: 这一进展部分得益于汽车制造商，他们正大力押注于电池驱动的电动汽车。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: But to win over these young workers, manufacturers have to clear another major hurdle: parents, who lived through the worst US economic downturn since the Great Depression, telling them to avoid the factory.
manufacturer.translationZh: 但是要赢得这些年轻工人的青睐，制造商还必须克服另一个重大障碍：那些经历过美国自大萧条以来最严重经济衰退的父母们，会告诫他们的孩子远离工厂。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: They are biased against car manufacturers .
manufacturer.translationZh: 它们对汽车制造商存在偏见。

mechanism.sentenceEn: Christopher Kettle, Biodiversity International's director for forest genetic resources and restoration in Rome, says that the need for infrastructure — things such as mechanisms for collecting and storing seeds, and nurseries to raise seedlings — might be most desperate here because many trees are 'masting' species, which don't produce seeds every year.
mechanism.translationZh: 位于罗马的国际生物多样性中心森林遗传资源与修复主管克里斯托弗·凯特尔表示，这里对基础设施（如种子采集和储存机制，以及培育幼苗的苗圃）的需求最为迫切，因为许多树木属于“大年结实”物种，并不会每年都产种。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

mechanism.sentenceEn: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
mechanism.translationZh: 然而，该法案提出的机制过于繁琐，并且在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

mechanism.sentenceEn: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism " in society should be profit and the market.
mechanism.translationZh: 她认为，诚信已经崩塌，因为我们集体接受了这样一种观念——社会中唯一的“分选机制”应该是利润和市场。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

mechanism.sentenceEn: There could be many mechanisms working together that drive us in choosing genetically similar friends rather than "functional kinship" of being friends with benefits!
mechanism.translationZh: 可能有多种机制共同作用，驱使我们选择基因相似的朋友，而非追求那种能带来好处的“功能性亲属关系”！
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

mechanism.sentenceEn: For a generation, the collective doctrine has been that the sorting mechanism of society should be profit.
mechanism.translationZh: 几十年来，我们奉行的共同信条是：社会的分选机制应当是利益。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

mechanism.sentenceEn: It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism – that is the culture of research, after all – but it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please.
mechanism.translationZh: 批评和质疑这种机制无可厚非——毕竟这是研究的文化——但这笔钱是奖项设立者的，他们有权随意支配。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

mood.sentenceEn: The clothes we choose can reflect our personality, mood , and identity.
mood.translationZh: 我们选择的着装可以反映我们的个性、心情和身份。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

mood.sentenceEn: When we wear clothes that make us feel comfortable and confident, it can positively affect our self-esteem and overall mood .
mood.translationZh: 当我们穿着令自己感到舒适且自信的衣服时，这能对我们的自尊心和整体情绪产生积极影响。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

mood.sentenceEn: Low mood , low energy, irritability and trouble sleeping could all be signs of poor social health.
mood.translationZh: 情绪低落、精力不足、易怒和睡眠障碍都可能是社交健康不佳的迹象。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

mood.sentenceEn: Loneliness is known to impact on your mental health and contribute to a low mood .
mood.translationZh: 众所周知，孤独会影响心理健康，并导致情绪低落。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

mood.sentenceEn: While that may well be true, researchers have also recently found that interacting with strangers actually brings a boost in mood and feelings of belonging that we didn't expect.
mood.translationZh: 虽然这很可能是事实，但研究人员最近还发现，与陌生人互动实际上能带来我们未曾预料到的情绪提升和归属感增强。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

mood.sentenceEn: Scientists have found that exposure to this hormone puts us in a trusting mood : In a Swiss study, researchers sprayed oxytocin into the noses of half the subjects; those subjects were ready to lend significantly higher amounts of money to strangers than were their counterparts who inhaled something else.
mood.translationZh: 科学家发现，接触这种激素会让我们产生信任情绪：在瑞士的一项研究中，研究人员向一半受试者的鼻腔喷洒了催产素；与吸入其他物质的受试者相比，这些人愿意借给陌生人的钱要多得多。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

moreover.sentenceEn: Moreover , cultural and societal influences play a significant role in shaping our dress choices.
moreover.translationZh: 此外，文化和社会影响在塑造我们的着装选择方面起着重要作用。
moreover.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

moreover.sentenceEn: Moreover , increased privatization would certainly undercut one of the major reasons why 300 million visitors come to the parks each year: to enjoy nature and get a break from the commercial drumbeat that overwhelms daily life.
moreover.translationZh: 此外，进一步私有化无疑会削弱每年吸引3亿游客前来公园的一个主要原因：享受自然，远离日常生活中无处不在的商业喧嚣。
moreover.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

moreover.sentenceEn: Moreover , we are grieving various kinds of loss: a friendship, a romantic relationship or a house.
moreover.translationZh: 此外，我们还在为各种各样的失去而悲伤：一段友谊、一段爱情或一所房子。
moreover.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

moreover.sentenceEn: These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today's live performances; moreover , they can be "consumed" at a time and place of the listener's choosing.
moreover.translationZh: 这些唱片价格低廉，随处可得，而且在艺术品质上往往远超当今的现场演出；更重要的是，听众可以自由选择欣赏它们的时间和地点。
moreover.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

moreover.sentenceEn: Moreover , the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
moreover.translationZh: 此外，音乐评论界的业余传统已经在急剧衰退。
moreover.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

moreover.sentenceEn: Moreover , some have been found to have a valuable function in building up soil fertility.
moreover.translationZh: 此外，人们还发现有些非经济林木在增强土壤肥力方面具有重要作用。
moreover.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

marketer.sentenceEn: The non-intrusive delivery of the marketing messages in a way that is sensitive to the needs of target customers is one of the critical challenges to the digital marketer .
marketer.translationZh: 以对目标客户需求敏感的方式实现营销信息的非侵入式传递，是数字营销人员面临的关键挑战之一。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

marketer.sentenceEn: Some believe that AI is negatively impacting on the marketer's role by reducing creativity and removing jobs, but they are aware that it is a way of reducing costs and creating new information.
marketer.translationZh: 一些人认为，人工智能通过降低创造力和减少就业机会，对营销人员的角色产生了负面影响，但他们也意识到，人工智能是一种降低成本和创造新信息的方式。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

marketer.sentenceEn: By allowing AI to develop content some brand marketers may find that they are losing control over the brand narrative.
marketer.translationZh: 如果允许人工智能生成内容，一些品牌营销人员可能会发现他们正在失去对品牌叙事的控制。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

marketer.sentenceEn: Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions.
marketer.translationZh: 企业应当与IT、合规、风险和法律团队共同商议，审查其隐私政策，并将负责公司用户界面的客户/用户体验设计师和编码人员，以及负责注册、结账购物车、定价和促销的营销人员与广告人员纳入讨论范围。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

marketer.sentenceEn: There are concerns that government, employers, and marketers might be able to access these data, thereby violating our privacy.
marketer.translationZh: 人们担心政府、雇主和营销人员可能会获取这些数据，从而侵犯我们的隐私。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

marketer.sentenceEn: But in some cases, one marketer's owned media become another marketer's paid media – for instance, when an e-commerce retailer sells ad space on its Web site.
marketer.translationZh: 但在某些情况下，一个营销者的自有媒体会成为另一个营销者的付费媒体——例如，当电子商务零售商在其网站上销售广告位时。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

mechanical.sentenceEn: He is a teacher at a New Hampshire high school where learning is not something of books and tests and mechanical memorization, but practical.
mechanical.translationZh: 他是新罕布什尔州一所高中的教师，在这所学校里，学习并非书本、考试和机械记忆的代名词，而是注重实践。
mechanical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

mechanical.sentenceEn: For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.
mechanical.translationZh: 例如，今日永存基金会（Long Now Foundation）的旗舰项目是一台机械钟，其设计目标是在数千年后仍能计时。
mechanical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

mechanical.sentenceEn: In his Case Study House, Ralph Rapson may have mispredicted just how the mechanical revolution would impact everyday life – few American families acquired helicopters, though most eventually got clothes dryers – but his belief that self-sufficiency was both desirable and inevitable was widely shared.
mechanical.translationZh: 在其案例研究住宅中，拉尔夫·拉普森或许错误预测了机械革命对日常生活的影响——尽管大多数美国家庭最终用上了烘干机，但拥有直升机的家庭寥寥无几——然而他关于自给自足既值得向往又不可避免的理念却得到了广泛认同。
mechanical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

mechanical.sentenceEn: Our banking is done at automated teller terminals that thank us with mechanical politeness for the transaction.
mechanical.translationZh: 我们的银行业务通过自动取款终端完成，这些终端会以机械的礼貌对我们的交易表示感谢。
mechanical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
mechanical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

mechanical.sentenceEn: And if scientists have yet to create the mechanical version of science fiction, they have begun to come close.
mechanical.translationZh: 虽然科学家们尚未创造出科幻小说中的机械版本，但他们已开始接近这个目标。
mechanical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
mechanical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

mechanical.translationZh: 机械设备得到了广泛应用。

merely.sentenceEn: One possibility was that they merely used their eyes and tried out the plants they found, but that would probably result in a lot of wasted time and energy, not least because their eyesight is actually not very good.
merely.translationZh: 一种可能性是它们仅仅依靠视觉来尝试所发现的植物，但这很可能会浪费大量时间和精力，尤其是因为它们的视力实际上并不好。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

merely.sentenceEn: It is too easy, and misleading, to see such court rulings as merely standing up for the rights of land owners when the consequences can be so dire for their neighbors.
merely.translationZh: 如果只将此类法院裁决视为维护土地所有者的权利，而忽视其可能给周边社区带来的严重后果，这种看法不仅过于简单，而且具有误导性。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

merely.sentenceEn: The Internet may be changing merely what we remember, not our capacity to do so, suggests Columbia University psychology professor Betsy Sparrow.
merely.translationZh: 哥伦比亚大学心理学教授贝齐·斯派洛指出，互联网可能仅仅改变了我们记忆的内容，而非我们的记忆能力。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

merely.sentenceEn: It says that the problem is not merely that people do bad science, but that our current system of career advancement positively encourages it.
merely.translationZh: 该论文指出，问题不仅仅在于人们从事劣质科研，更在于我们当前的职业晋升体系对这种行为起到了积极的鼓励作用。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

merely.sentenceEn: Ms Denham chose to concentrate the blame on the NHS trust, since under existing law it "controlled" the data and DeepMind merely "processed" it.
merely.translationZh: 德纳姆女士选择将责任集中归咎于英国国家医疗服务体系信托机构，因为根据现行法律，该机构对数据拥有'控制权'，而DeepMind仅仅是进行'数据处理'。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

merely.sentenceEn: Merely helping a gift-giver gain access to other officials, unless done with clear intent to pressure those officials, is not corruption, the justices found.
merely.translationZh: 大法官们裁定，仅仅帮助送礼者接触到其他官员并不构成腐败，除非此举带有明确向这些官员施压的意图。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

minister.sentenceEn: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers .
minister.translationZh: 正因如此，改革智库在十位前卫生部长的支持下，启动了一项名为“重塑健康”的新工作方案。
minister.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

minister.sentenceEn: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
minister.translationZh: 部长们还应致力于增强租赁市场环境的确定性，这将对注册住房供应商依靠收入为新开发项目融资的能力产生重大影响。
minister.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

minister.sentenceEn: The communities minister , Don Foster, has hinted that George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt.
minister.translationZh: 社区大臣唐·福斯特暗示，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本可能会对地方政府住房存量债务的借款额度现行上限采取更灵活的政策。
minister.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

minister.sentenceEn: Leading doctors today weigh in on the debate over the government's role in promoting public health by demanding that ministers impose "fat taxes" on unhealthy food and introduce cigarette-style warnings to children about the dangers of a poor diet.
minister.translationZh: 今日，顶尖医生们就政府在促进公众健康方面的角色参与辩论，他们要求部长们对不健康食品征收“脂肪税”，并以香烟式警告的形式向儿童宣传不良饮食的危害。
minister.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

minister.sentenceEn: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise.
minister.translationZh: 欧洲各国部长立即要求国际会计准则理事会(IASB)采取同样的做法。
minister.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

minister.sentenceEn: The most thoroughly studied intellectuals in the history of the New World are the ministers and political leaders of seventeenth-century New England.
minister.translationZh: 在新大陆的历史上，被研究得最为透彻的知识分子是17世纪新英格兰地区的牧师和政治领袖。
minister.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
minister.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

mix.sentenceEn: Perhaps most encouraging of all is a paper from 2022 by researchers at Stanford University that involved a mix of contrived help-seeking interactions and asking people to recall times they'd sought help in the past.
mix.translationZh: 或许最令人鼓舞的是斯坦福大学研究人员2022年发表的一篇论文，该研究结合了人为设计的求助互动实验和要求人们回忆过去求助经历的调查。
mix.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

mix.sentenceEn: The miracle of the Chesapeake Bay lies not in its depths, but in the complexity of its natural construction, the interaction of fresh and saline waters, and the mix of land and water.
mix.translationZh: 切萨皮克湾的奇迹不在于其深度，而在于其复杂的自然构造、淡水与咸水的交汇融合，以及陆地与水域的相互交织。

mix.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

But are they good for the American economy? I don't know."

mix.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

mix.sentenceEn: The dual aim was mixed up: The stress on success over taking part was intimidating for newcomers.

mix.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

mix.sentenceEn: As adults, it seems that we are constantly pursuing happiness, often with mixed results.
mix.translationZh: 作为成年人，我们似乎一直在追求幸福，但其结果往往喜忧参半。

male.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

male.sentenceEn: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male .
male.translationZh: 尤其是，企业职场永远不会真正实现家庭友好，除非女性能够参与高层管理决策，而欧洲企业治理高层职位仍由男性占据绝对多数。
male.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

male.sentenceEn: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
male.translationZh: 泰勒案的判决还宣布在陪审团遴选中存在性别歧视是违宪的，并命令各州在遴选男性和女性陪审员时采用相同的程序。
male.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

male.sentenceEn: Studies of both animals and humans have shown that sex hormones somehow affect the stress response, causing females under stress to produce more of the trigger chemicals than do males under the same conditions.
male.translationZh: 对动物和人类的研究都表明，性激素会以某种方式影响应激反应，使处于压力下的雌性比相同条件下的雄性产生更多触发化学物质。

male.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

male.sentenceEn: In several of the studies, when stressed-out female rats had their ovaries (the female reproductive organs) removed, their chemical responses became equal to those of the males .
male.translationZh: 在几项研究中，当饱受压力的雌鼠被切除卵巢（雌性生殖器官）后，它们的化学物质反应变得与雄鼠相同。
male.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

meaningful.sentenceEn: Yet despite two decades of strategies and a number of major health reforms, we have failed to make meaningful progress on any of these aims.
meaningful.translationZh: 然而，尽管二十年来我们制定了各种策略并实施了多项重大医疗改革，但在实现这些目标方面我们并未取得实质性进展。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

meaningful.sentenceEn: If we are serious about ensuring that our science is both meaningful and reproducible, we must ensure that our institutions encourage that kind of science.
meaningful.translationZh: 如果我们真的想要确保我们的科学研究既有意义又可重复验证，就必须确保我们的学术机构鼓励这种类型的科研。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

meaningful.sentenceEn: The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up – perhaps just in time to have a meaningful effect in slowing climate change.
meaningful.translationZh: 能源来源的变革速度似乎正在加快——这或许恰逢其时，能对减缓气候变化产生积极影响。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

meaningful.sentenceEn: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.
meaningful.translationZh: 在被评估的163个国家中，英国在将经济增长转化为公民切实福祉方面表现最差之一。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

meaningful.translationZh: 他们会收到更没有意义、更缺乏针对性的广告。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

meaningful.sentenceEn: The networked computer offers the first chance in 50 years to reverse the flow, to encourage thoughtful downloading and, even more importantly, meaningful uploading.
meaningful.translationZh: 联网计算机提供了50年来第一个逆转这种流向的机会，它鼓励经过思考的下载，更重要的是，鼓励有意义的上传。

military.sentenceEn: Battles increasingly depended on new military technologies such as radar and the proximity fuze.
military.translationZh: 战争日益依赖于雷达和近炸引信等新型军事技术。
military.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

military.sentenceEn: G.I. is just a military abbreviation meaning Government Issue, and it was on all of the articles handed out to soldiers.
military.translationZh: G.I.只是一个军事缩写，意为“政府配给”，所有分发给士兵的物品上都印有这个标识。
military.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

military.sentenceEn: Millions of Americans and foreigners see G.I. Joe as a mindless war toy, the symbol of American military adventurism, but that's not how it used to be.
military.translationZh: 数百万美国人和外国人将美国大兵乔视为毫无意义的战争玩具，是美国军事冒险主义的象征，但它过去并非如此。
military.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

military.sentenceEn: Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.
military.translationZh: 相比之下，货运飞机或许更容易重新安排时间，常规军事飞行也一样。
military.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

military.sentenceEn: There are reports that some military aircraft flew in formation when they were low on fuel during the Second World War, but Dr. Lissaman says they are unsubstantiated.
military.translationZh: 有报道称，二战期间一些军用飞机在燃油不足时会编队飞行，但利萨曼博士表示这些说法并无实据。
military.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

military.sentenceEn: She says that, unlike those for basketball, the length of military uniforms has not changed for some time.
military.translationZh: 她说，与篮球队服不同，军装的长度已有相当长一段时间没有改变了。
military.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
military.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

millennial.sentenceEn: Millennials were told that if you did well in school, got a decent degree, you would be set up for life.
millennial.translationZh: 千禧一代曾被告知，只要在校成绩优异，拿到不错的学位，就能一劳永逸地安身立命。
millennial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

millennial.sentenceEn: Thankfully, there are signs that this is already happening, with Generation Z seeking to learn from their millennial predecessors, even if parents and teachers tend to be still set in the degree mindset.
millennial.translationZh: 值得庆幸的是，有迹象表明这种情况已经在发生：Z世代正试图从前辈千禧一代的经历中吸取教训，尽管家长和教师们往往仍固守着对学位的执念。
millennial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

millennial.sentenceEn: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
millennial.translationZh: 如果说“有 entitlement 心态”是人们用来形容千禧一代（1981年至1995年出生的人）最常见的形容词——无论这种说法是否公平——那么Z世代的关键词则是务实和谨慎。
millennial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

millennial.sentenceEn: " Millennials wanted more flexibility in their lives," notes Tanya Michelsen, Associate Director of YouthSight, a UK-based brand manager that conducts regular 60-day surveys of British youth, in findings that might just as well apply to American youth.
millennial.translationZh: 英国品牌管理公司YouthSight的副总监Tanya Michelsen指出：'千禧一代希望生活有更大的灵活性。'该公司定期对英国年轻人进行为期60天的调查，其研究结果同样适用于美国年轻人。
millennial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

millennial.sentenceEn: Julie Parks of Grand Rapids Community College points to another key to luring Millennials into manufacturing: a work/life balance.
millennial.translationZh: 大急流城社区学院的朱莉·帕克斯指出了吸引千禧一代进入制造业的另一个关键因素：工作与生活的平衡。
millennial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

millennial.sentenceEn: Millennials may not be that interested in taking their place.
millennial.translationZh: 千禧一代可能对接替他们的岗位不太感兴趣。
millennial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

misleading.sentenceEn: It is too easy, and misleading , to see such court rulings as merely standing up for the rights of land owners when the consequences can be so dire for their neighbors.
misleading.translationZh: 如果只将此类法院裁决视为维护土地所有者的权利，而忽视其可能给周边社区带来的严重后果，这种看法不仅过于简单，而且具有误导性。
misleading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

misleading.sentenceEn: Section 5 of the FTC Act empowers the FTC to initiate enforcement action against unfair or deceptive acts, meaning the FTC can only act after the fact if a company's privacy practices are misleading or cause unjustified consumer harm.
misleading.translationZh: 《联邦贸易委员会法案》第5条授权联邦贸易委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为采取执法行动，这意味着只有当某公司的隐私做法具有误导性或对消费者造成不正当损害时，联邦贸易委员会才能在事后采取行动。
misleading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

misleading.sentenceEn: Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues, such as certain gestures or utterances, rather than letting the complex interplay of subtle signals form a holistic impression.
misleading.translationZh: 安巴迪猜测，深思熟虑使参与者将注意力集中在那些鲜明但具有误导性的线索上，比如某些手势或话语，而未能让微妙信号间的复杂相互作用形成一个整体印象。
misleading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

misleading.sentenceEn: A string of accidents, including the partial collapse of a cooling tower in 2007 and the discovery of an underground pipe system leakage, raised serious questions about both Vermont Yankee's safety and Entergy's management – especially after the company made misleading statements about the pipe.
misleading.translationZh: 一系列事故，包括2007年一座冷却塔的部分坍塌以及地下管道系统泄漏的发现，引发了人们对佛蒙特扬基核电站安全性和安特吉公司管理能力的严重质疑——尤其是在该公司就管道问题发表了误导性声明之后。
misleading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

misleading.sentenceEn: It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to misleading interpretations of what happened.
misleading.translationZh: 事实证明，实验所采用的特殊方式可能导致了对所发生情况的误导性解释。
misleading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

motion.sentenceEn: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
motion.translationZh: 据代表好莱坞各大制片厂的行业组织——美国电影协会（MPA）称，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。该协会正致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。

motion.sentenceEn: For example, a busy street might not suit a motion -sensored door, as it would constantly be opening for passers-by.

motion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

motion.sentenceEn: Accommodating this new world of people in motion will require new attitudes on both sides of the immigration battle.
motion.translationZh: 要适应这个人口流动的新世界，移民问题争论双方都需要转变态度。
motion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

motion.sentenceEn: Newton's laws of motion and Darwinian evolution each bind a host of different phenomena into a single explicatory framework.
motion.translationZh: 牛顿运动定律和达尔文进化论均将众多不同现象纳入统一的解释框架之中。
motion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

motion.sentenceEn: It was during the same time that the communications revolution speeded up, beginning with transport, the railway, and leading on through the telegraph, the telephone, radio, and motion pictures into the 20th century world of the motor car and the airplane.
motion.translationZh: 与此同时，通信革命也加速发展，它始于交通运输（尤其是铁路），随后依次出现了电报、电话、无线电和电影，最终迈入了20世纪的汽车与飞机时代。

multinational.translationZh: 这些单边举措在具体细节上各有不同，但它们的共同目的是对跨国公司的收入和营收征税。各国认为自己有权对此类收入征税，即便国际税收规则并未赋予它们这一权利。
multinational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

multinational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

multinational.sentenceEn: They have included Britain's DPT. (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL ( multinational anti-avoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few.
multinational.translationZh: 其中包括英国的DPT（转移利润税）、澳大利亚的MAAL（跨国反避税法）以及印度的SEP（显著经济存在）测试，仅举几例。
multinational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

multinational.sentenceEn: In Argentina, for instance, after the reforms of the early 1990s, multinationals went from 43% to almost 70% of the industrial production of the 200 largest firms.
multinational.translationZh: 例如，在阿根廷，20世纪90年代初改革之后，跨国公司在该国200家最大企业工业产值中所占比例从43%上升到了近70%。

muscle.translationZh: 一项研究发现，肌肉流失和腹部脂肪堆积与流体智力下降有关。

muscle.translationZh: 与此同时，随着年龄增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并维持肌肉量，以保护你的身心健康。
muscle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

muscle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

muscle.sentenceEn: I had gained weight in the form of muscle mass, but thinking only of lowering the number on the scale, I altered my training program.

muscle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

manner.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

manner.sentenceEn: His function is analogous to that of a judge, who must accept the obligation of revealing in as obvious a manner as possible the course of reasoning which led him to his decision.
manner.translationZh: 他的职责类似于法官，法官必须承担起义务，以尽可能清晰的方式揭示自己做出决定的推理过程。
manner.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

manner.sentenceEn: Social science is that branch of intellectual enquiry which seeks to study humans and their endeavors in the same reasoned, orderly, systematic, and dispassioned manner that natural scientists use for the study of natural phenomena.
manner.translationZh: 社会科学是知识探索的一个分支，它致力于以自然科学家研究自然现象时所采用的那种理性、有序、系统且客观的方式，来研究人类及其活动。
manner.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

manner.sentenceEn: Therefore, it is important to study humans in all their richness and diversity in a calm and systematic manner , with the hope that the knowledge resulting from such studies can lead humans to a more harmonious way of living with themselves and with all other life forms on this planet Earth.
manner.translationZh: 因此，以冷静系统的方式研究人类的丰富性和多样性至关重要，希望这些研究产生的知识能引导人类与自身以及地球上所有其他生命形式建立更和谐的共存方式。
manner.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

manner.sentenceEn: Include a few casual and apparently off-the-cuff remarks which you can deliver in a relaxed and unforced manner .
manner.translationZh: 你可以加入一些随意且看似即兴的话语，以轻松自然的方式表达出来。
manner.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

manner.sentenceEn: The challenge the computer mounts to television thus bears little similarity to one format being replaced by another in the manner of record players being replaced by CD players.
manner.translationZh: 因此，计算机对电视构成的挑战，与黑胶唱片机被CD播放机取代这类格式更替几乎没有相似之处。

mere.sentenceEn: A hundred years on from Marconi and Reith, is the art of mere listening endangered?
mere.translationZh: 从马可尼和里思的时代至今已过百年，单纯“听”的艺术是否已面临消亡？
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

mere.sentenceEn: We are amazed today at the mere number of plays produced, as well as by the number of dramatists writing at the same time for this London of two hundred thousand inhabitants.
mere.translationZh: 如今，我们不仅对当时创作的戏剧数量之多感到惊讶，也对同时为这座仅有二十万居民的伦敦城进行创作的剧作家数量感到震惊。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

mere.sentenceEn: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
mere.translationZh: 但这种区分忽略了一个关键点：赋予数据价值的是对数据的处理和整合，而非仅仅拥有这些数据。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

mere.sentenceEn: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above " mere " politics and "embody" a spirit of national unity.
mere.translationZh: 当公众舆论出现严重两极分化时——正如佛朗哥政权结束后的情况那样——君主能够超越"纯粹的"政治，"体现"国家统一的精神。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

mere.sentenceEn: These epochal figures represented lives hard to imitate, but to be acknowledged as possessing higher authority than mere mortals.
mere.translationZh: 这些划时代人物的人生虽难以效仿，但其拥有的超越凡人的崇高权威却是公认的。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

mere.sentenceEn: So when one monkey was handed a grape in exchange for her token, the second was reluctant to hand hers over for a mere piece of cucumber.
mere.translationZh: 因此，当一只猴子用代币换到一颗葡萄时，另一只猴子就不愿意用自己的代币只换取一片黄瓜了。
mere.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

merger.sentenceEn: It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher, Simon & Schuster—the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.
merger.translationZh: 这一切发生之际，作者们本已在担忧企鹅兰登书屋与另一家大型出版商西蒙与舒斯特出版社拟议合并可能带来的后果——英国独立出版商数量的减少可能会导致竞价竞争减少、预付款降低，以及出版内容更趋同质化。
merger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

merger.sentenceEn: Supporters of the new supersystems argue that these mergers will allow for substantial cost reductions and better coordinated service.
merger.translationZh: 新超级铁路系统的支持者认为，这些合并将大幅降低成本，并实现更协调的服务。
merger.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
merger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

merger.sentenceEn: Next year, after a series of mergers is completed, just four railroads will control well over 90 percent of all the freight moved by major rail carriers.
merger.translationZh: 到明年，一系列并购完成后，仅四家铁路公司将控制主要铁路运营商货运量的90%以上。
merger.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
merger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

merger.sentenceEn: Yet it is hard to imagine that the merger of a few oil firms today could re-create the same threats to competition that were feared nearly a century ago in the U.S., when the Standard Oil trust was broken up.
merger.translationZh: 然而，很难想象今天几家石油公司的合并会重现近一个世纪前在美国引发的那种对竞争的威胁，当时标准石油托拉斯被分拆。
merger.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
merger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

merger.sentenceEn: The world is going through the biggest wave of mergers and acquisitions ever witnessed.
merger.translationZh: 世界正经历着有史以来最大规模的并购浪潮。
merger.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
merger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

merger.sentenceEn: The merger of publishers is a worrying trend.
merger.translationZh: 出版商合并是一个令人担忧的趋势。

mandate.sentenceEn: When Tom Swetnam joined the U.S. Forest Service in the 1970s, his mandate was to "put everything out," he recalled.
mandate.translationZh: 汤姆·斯威特南回想起他在 20 世纪 70 年代加入美国林业局时，得到的指示是“扑灭一切火情”。
mandate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

mandate.sentenceEn: "Some states require physicians to report, others allow but do not mandate reports, while a few consider a report a breach of confidentiality. There could be liability and penalties if a physician does not act in accordance with state laws on reporting and confidentiality," she counseled.
mandate.translationZh: 她建议道：“有些州要求医生报告，有些州允许但不强制报告，还有少数州则认为报告是对保密性的侵犯。如果医生未按照州有关报告和保密的法律行事，可能会承担责任并面临处罚。”
mandate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

mandate.sentenceEn: The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy.
mandate.translationZh: 该法案要求每位民宿房东在州政府登记注册，强制他们购买保险，并在新增的州税基础上为地方税的征收创造了可能性。
mandate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

mandate.sentenceEn: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field.
mandate.translationZh: 进步派常常支持多元化指令，将其视为实现平等和创造公平竞争环境的途径。
mandate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

mandate.sentenceEn: But are such government mandates even necessary?
mandate.translationZh: 但这类政府指令真的有必要吗？
mandate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

mandate.sentenceEn: Not everyone will agree with the authors' policy ideas, which range from mandating more holiday time to reducing tax incentives for American homebuyers.
mandate.translationZh: 并非所有人都会认同作者提出的政策建议，这些建议涵盖了从强制增加休假时间到减少对美国购房者的税收优惠等多个方面。
mandate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

margin.sentenceEn: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
margin.translationZh: 据代表好莱坞各大制片厂的行业组织——美国电影协会（MPA）称，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。该协会正致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。
margin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

margin.sentenceEn: Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.
margin.translationZh: 在出版行业其他领域深陷生存危机之际，科学出版商却持续公布其业务利润率接近40%。
margin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

margin.sentenceEn: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.
margin.translationZh: 而被边缘化、失去重要性的词汇则是正义、公平、宽容、均衡和责任。
margin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

margin.sentenceEn: Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
margin.translationZh: 此外，批发业务的平均整体利润率高于零售业务；随着越来越多的欧洲人更频繁地外出就餐，食品服务行业的批发需求正在快速增长；而这个分散行业的竞争动态变化最终使批发商整合成为可能。

margin.sentenceEn: The winner, by a large margin , was a tiny Virginia company called Open Source Solutions, whose clear advantage was its mastery of the electronic world.
margin.translationZh: 以明显优势胜出的是弗吉尼亚州一家名为“开源解决方案”的小公司，其显著优势在于对电子世界的精通。
margin.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
margin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

margin.sentenceEn: To make revising easier, leave wide margins and extra space between lines so that you can easily add words, sentences, and corrections. Write on only one side of the paper.
margin.translationZh: 为了便于修改，请留出较宽的页边距和行间距，这样你可以轻松添加词语、句子和修改内容。只在纸张的一面书写。
margin.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

millennium.sentenceEn: For millennia , the city's remains lay unseen below some 13 feet of water.
millennium.translationZh: 数千年来，这座城市的遗迹一直沉睡在约13英尺深的水下，无人知晓。
millennium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

millennium.sentenceEn: For millennia , we've known what we've known due to artifacts that have survived, often despite their original creators' neglect.
millennium.translationZh: 数千年来，我们所了解的知识往往源于那些历经岁月留存下来的文物，尽管它们的原创造者可能早已将其遗忘。
millennium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

millennium.sentenceEn: Recognising the hope that science and engineering can bring was the impetus behind the creation of the Millennium Technology Prize, which is now entering its 20th year as a celebration of human ingenuity.
millennium.translationZh: 认识到科学与工程所能带来的希望，是创立千禧技术奖的初衷。如今，这项彰显人类智慧的奖项已迈入第20个年头。
millennium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

millennium.sentenceEn: The Romans buried the nails so deep that they would not be discovered for almost two millennia .
millennium.translationZh: 罗马人将这些钉子埋得如此之深，以至于将近两千年的时间里都未被人发现。
millennium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

millennium.sentenceEn: Not only did they develop such a device, but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
millennium.translationZh: 他们不仅发明了这样一种设备，还在世纪之交成功将其嵌入到一个每天有数十亿人访问的全球系统中。
millennium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

millennium.sentenceEn: According to BT's futurologist, Ian Pearson, these are among the developments scheduled for the first few decades of the new millennium (a period of 1,000 years), when supercomputers will dramatically accelerate progress in all areas of life.
millennium.translationZh: 英国电信的未来学家伊恩·皮尔森认为，这些都属于新千年（一段1000年的时期）最初几十年内计划实现的发展，届时超级计算机将极大地加速生活各个领域的进步。
millennium.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
millennium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

minimum.sentenceEn: U.S. customers historically tipped people they assumed were earning most of their income via tips, such as restaurant servers earning less than the minimum wage.
minimum.translationZh: 美国顾客历来会给那些他们认为主要靠小费收入的人小费，比如收入低于最低工资的餐厅服务员。
minimum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

minimum.sentenceEn: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
minimum.translationZh: 小费一直是传统小费服务行业工作者的重要收入来源，例如餐厅，这些行业的小费最低工资标准可低至每小时2.13美元。
minimum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

minimum.sentenceEn: The Government has pledged to change the law to introduce a minimum service requirement so that, even when strikes occur, services can continue to operate.
minimum.translationZh: 政府已承诺修改法律，引入最低服务要求，以确保即使发生罢工，铁路服务也能继续运营。
minimum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

minimum.sentenceEn: Imagine that you favor increasing the minimum wage in our state, and I do not.
minimum.translationZh: 假设你支持提高我们州的最低工资，而我不支持。

minimum.sentenceEn: Then I counter with another reasonable argument: that a higher minimum wage will force businesses to employ fewer people for less time.
minimum.translationZh: 那么我会用另一个合理的论点反驳：提高最低工资会迫使企业减少雇佣人数、缩短雇佣时间。

minimum.sentenceEn: If it clears the House, this measure would still have to get through the Senate – where someone is bound to point out that it amounts to the bare, bare minimum necessary to keep the Postal Service afloat, not comprehensive reform.
minimum.translationZh: 即使该法案在众议院获得通过，仍需经过参议院的审议——届时必定会有人指出，这不过是维持邮政总局运转所需的最低限度措施，并非全面改革。
minimum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

mixed.sentenceEn: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
mixed.translationZh: 混合系统意味着高铁在特定路线或穿过大城市时，必须在普速轨道上行驶。
mixed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

mixed.sentenceEn: "We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there's a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex," he said.
mixed.translationZh: 他说：“我们的系统很复杂，没有多余的缓冲空间。只要线路上出现一点小问题，情况就会变得异常棘手。”
mixed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

mixed.sentenceEn: It sends a mixed message, and your counterpart gets to choose what signals to read.
mixed.translationZh: 这会传递出混杂的信号，让对方自行解读你的意图。
mixed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

mixed.sentenceEn: While more families buck an older-generation proclivity to leave kids in the dark about real estate decisions, realty agents and psychologists have mixed views about the financial, personal and long-term effects kids' opinions may have.
mixed.translationZh: 尽管越来越多的家庭不再像老一辈那样倾向于在房产决策中把孩子蒙在鼓里，但房地产经纪人和心理学家对孩子的意见可能产生的经济、个人及长期影响看法不一。
mixed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

mixed.sentenceEn: Evidence that the loveLife program produces lasting changes is limited and mixed .
mixed.translationZh: 有证据表明，loveLife项目带来持久改变的效果有限且喜忧参半。
mixed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

mixed.sentenceEn: Early promises to end Indian tribute and taxes on people of mixed origin came much slower because the new nations still needed the revenue such policies produced.
mixed.translationZh: 然而，废除印第安人贡税和混血人种赋税的早期承诺却迟迟未能兑现，因为新兴国家仍然需要这些政策所带来的财政收入。
mixed.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
mixed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

mobile.sentenceEn: When Microsoft bought task management app Wunderlist and mobile calendar Sunrise in 2015, it picked two newcomers that were attracting considerable buzz in Silicon Valley.
mobile.translationZh: 2015年，微软收购任务管理应用Wunderlist和移动日历应用Sunrise时，选中的是两家在硅谷已引起不小轰动的新兴企业。
mobile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

mobile.sentenceEn: Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise.
mobile.translationZh: 雷德斯基通过让母子（女）二人组参与一项食物测试活动，研究了他们在进餐时间使用手机和平板电脑的情况。
mobile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

mobile.sentenceEn: And though print ad sales still dwarf their online and mobile counterparts, revenue from print is still declining.
mobile.translationZh: 尽管印刷广告销售额仍远超线上和移动广告，但印刷业务的收入仍在下滑。
mobile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

mobile.sentenceEn: The Supreme Court will now consider whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant if the phone is on or around a person during an arrest.
mobile.translationZh: 最高法院现在将审议：当一个人被捕时，如果其手机在身上或身旁，警方是否可以在没有搜查令的情况下搜查该手机内容。
mobile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

mobile.sentenceEn: Fast-food chains should also stop offering "inducements" such as toys, cute animals and mobile phone credit to lure young customers, Stephenson said.
mobile.translationZh: 斯蒂芬森表示，快餐连锁店还应停止提供玩具、可爱动物形象以及手机话费等“引诱物”来吸引年轻顾客。
mobile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

mobile.sentenceEn: Software, consultancy and mobile telephones use far less oil than steel or car production.
mobile.translationZh: 软件、咨询及移动电话行业的石油消耗量远低于钢铁或汽车制造业。
mobile.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
mobile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

mode.sentenceEn: For all the possibilities of our new culture machines, most people are still stuck in download mode .
mode.translationZh: 尽管我们的新文化机器蕴藏着无限可能，但大多数人仍停留在下载模式。
mode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

mode.sentenceEn: The networked computer is an amazing device, the first media machine that serves as the mode of production, means of distribution, site of reception, and place of praise and critique.
mode.translationZh: 联网计算机是一种了不起的设备，它是第一台集生产方式、传播手段、接收平台以及评论场所于一体的媒体机器。
mode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

mode.sentenceEn: First, most people do not realise that there are strong commercial agendas at work to keep them in passive consumption mode .
mode.translationZh: 首先，大多数人没有意识到，一些强大的商业议程正在起作用，目的是让他们一直处于被动消费模式。
mode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

mode.sentenceEn: At the end of adolescence, however, the brain shuts down half of that capacity, preserving only those modes of thought that have seemed most valuable during the first decade or so of life.
mode.translationZh: 然而，在青春期结束时，大脑会关闭一半的这种能力，只保留那些在生命最初十年左右似乎最有价值的思维模式。
mode.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
mode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

mode.sentenceEn: The current emphasis on standardized testing highlights analysis and procedure, meaning that few of us inherently use our innovative and collaborative modes of thought.
mode.translationZh: 当前对标准化测试的重视，突出了分析和程序化思维，这意味着我们中很少有人会本能地运用创新和协作的思维模式。
mode.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
mode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

mode.sentenceEn: A new mode of publication is emerging.
mode.translationZh: 一种新的出版模式正在兴起。
mode.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

modest.sentenceEn: From then on his sketches, which appeared under the pen name "Boz" in The Evening Chronicle, earned him a modest reputation.
modest.translationZh: 从那以后，他以“博兹”为笔名在《纪事晚报》上发表的速写为他赢得了小小的名气。

modest.sentenceEn: The court would be recklessly modest if it followed California's advice.
modest.translationZh: 如果最高法院采纳加州的建议，那将是一种鲁莽的保守。
modest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

modest.sentenceEn: Their thesis – that a relatively modest intervention could have a big impact – was based on the view that first-generation students may be most lacking not in potential but in practical knowledge about how to deal with the issues that face most college students.
modest.translationZh: 他们的论点——一项相对简单的干预措施可能会产生重大影响——基于这样一种观点：第一代大学生最缺乏的可能不是潜力，而是如何应对大多数大学生所面临问题的实用知识。
modest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

modest.sentenceEn: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday – a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
modest.translationZh: 美国最高法院周一以5票对3票的表决结果，否决了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分内容——这对奥巴马政府而言是一场不大不小的政策胜利。
modest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

modest.sentenceEn: Politicians have repeatedly "backloaded" public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous.
modest.translationZh: 政客们一再采用"后加载"的方式处理公共部门的薪酬协议，保持适度的薪资增长，却增加了假期，尤其是本已丰厚的养老金。
modest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

modest.sentenceEn: In the 1930s Frank Lloyd Wright started building more modest and efficient houses – usually around 1,200 square feet – than the spreading two-story ones he had designed in the 1890s and the early 20th century.
modest.translationZh: 20世纪30年代，弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特开始设计建造更简约实用的住宅——通常面积约为1200平方英尺——相比他在19世纪90年代和20世纪初设计的那些宽敞的两层住宅要小得多。
modest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

monopoly.sentenceEn: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
monopoly.translationZh: 关键问题在于，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发它们的私人垄断企业。
monopoly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

monopoly.sentenceEn: Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's.
monopoly.translationZh: 批评者对基因专利提出了三个主要反对理由：基因是自然产物，因此不应被授予专利；基因专利会抑制而非奖励创新；专利垄断会限制人们获取像Myriad公司这样的基因检测服务。
monopoly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

monopoly.sentenceEn: So disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
monopoly.translationZh: 因此，各学科不仅垄断了知识的生产，还垄断了知识生产者的培养。

monopoly.sentenceEn: Any threat of monopoly , they argue, is removed by fierce competition from trucks.
monopoly.translationZh: 他们认为，来自公路货运的激烈竞争会消除任何垄断威胁。
monopoly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
monopoly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

monopoly.sentenceEn: In recent years, railroads have been combining with each other, merging into supersystems, causing heightened concerns about monopoly .
monopoly.translationZh: 近年来，铁路公司不断相互合并，形成超大型铁路系统，这引发了人们对垄断的日益担忧。
monopoly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
monopoly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

motivate.sentenceEn: With so much research left to do, leaders in the field have been doing some soul-searching, and acknowledging that restoration can be motivated by — and designed to meet — different needs.
motivate.translationZh: 面对繁重的研究任务，该领域的领军人物一直在进行反思，并承认修复工作的动力和设计初衷可以源于不同的需求。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

motivate.sentenceEn: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: "The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish."
motivate.translationZh: 当被问及是否有特定论文推动了这一变革时，麦克纳特表示：“‘统计委员会’的成立是受到对科学研究中统计和数据分析应用的普遍担忧所驱动，同时也是《科学》杂志提高其所发表研究可重复性的整体努力的一部分。”
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

motivate.sentenceEn: Not only are the tasks apparently infinite, the co-workers are much harder to motivate .
motivate.translationZh: 不仅家务任务似乎永无止境，家里的“同事们”也更难调动积极性。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

motivate.sentenceEn: This new focus on personal fulfillment can help keep employees motivated amid increasingly loud debates over work-life balance.
motivate.translationZh: 这种对个人成就感的新关注有助于在关于工作与生活平衡的争论日益激烈的情况下，保持员工的积极性。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

motivate.sentenceEn: What motivated him, we were to understand, was his zeal for "fundamental fairness" – protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending and ensuring that only the most deserving claimants received their benefits.
motivate.translationZh: 我们应当理解，促使他这样做的是他对“基本公平”的热忱——保护纳税人，控制开支，并确保只有最值得帮助的申领者才能获得福利。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句
